scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Raw Panda contact-only regularization, solved inertial reference/time axes and actual native replay

contact_only_regularization.scope: Audit raw rigid penetration and fixed-step contact-regularization sensitivity.
contact_only_regularization.limitations: Raw collider penetration is a solver-regularization observable, not material deformation. The independent body mesh agrees with runtime collision vertices within the declared geometry guard. Force/depth ratios are state diagnostics, not a universal contact stiffness; dynamics and solver impedance also contribute. Contact-only time constants change at fixed geometry, material, actuation, integration interval and recorded temporary-weld parameters. Three levels do not by themselves establish a credible zero-regularization tail. The body may retain angular motion; solved deformable/dynamic contact, support/history matching and native load replay remain required before interpreting deformation feedback or physical operating range.

temporal_axis.scope: Compare solved inertial contact at exact common times and fixed physical laws.
temporal_axis.limitations: Three inertial time resolutions retain the same held-row initial state, gravity, material, actual rigid fingers, clippedPD/passive damping, physical friction mollifier velocity and0.1s horizon. All saved steps satisfy their original full mapped/body dynamic-force gates. Common-time fields are unsmoothed original corner tensors; reported L2 values are discrete common-grid diagnostics rather than continuum physical accuracy. No spatial/contact regularization or matching to the rigid weld/full arm is inferred. Raw corner lower peaks and whole-volume nonlinear upper peaks remain separate.

native_replay.scope: Replay solved inertial Panda loads and quantify full-inertia versus rigid relief.
native_replay.limitations: Same-nodal-load native algebra gates use actual raw tensors and the global peak. Reference-volume nonlinear comparisons are one coarse solved dynamic state, not finite-footprint mapping, spatial/contact convergence or full-arm matching. The full-inertia diagnostic retains elastic acceleration but still uses reference geometry and linear constitutive response; its difference is not an exact causal decomposition. Fitted angular velocity is a backward finite rotation rate. Actual contact forces are rotated without changing their values; deformation-induced application moments are retained.

figure_qa.observations: Readable/unclipped paired markers, source legend, axes and wall reference. Deterministic raw contact values are retained; no statistical uncertainty or unmeasured curves are drawn.

summary.earlier_attempts: Original replay v1 omits required surface_triangles and fails before native recovery. Plot v1 omits an imported inactive mesh-generator definition from its source list; selected v2 captures it. Earlier energy-free temporal audit is retained, selected v2 adds body elastic and full kinetic energy.

limitations: Rigid contact-only time constants change at fixed1.25ms dt and actual weld parameters, with raw penetrations and finite-face geometry checks. Default overlap approaches wall thickness; the3.010% force tail remains unqualified. Independent inertial actual-finger references solve140 steps with unchanged dynamic force gates and three temporal controls at one coarse spatial/contact setting. One actual native nodal replay is qualified; it is not finite-footprint/model/spatial accuracy. Original asset/source-coverage failures remain exact. Different initializers, friction/contact regularization, longer histories and omitted full-arm/finger-equality behavior require matching. Live U/full egg are excluded. The complete original physical/model/feedback/cost objective remains active. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
